```yaml
name: Rule Type Param Changes Comment

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, labeled, unlabeled]

jobs:
  comment-on-rule-type-changes:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Check for rule type parameter changes
        id: check_changes
        run: |
          # Check if this PR modifies rule type parameters
          CHANGED_FILES=$(git diff --name-only HEAD~1 HEAD)
          RULE_TYPE_CHANGES=false
          
          for file in $CHANGED_FILES; do
            if [[ "$file" == *"rule"* ]] && [[ "$file" == *".ts" ]] || [[ "$file" == *".js" ]]; then
              if git diff HEAD~1 HEAD -- "$file" | grep -q "ruleType\|ruleTypeId"; then
                RULE_TYPE_CHANGES=true
                break
              fi
            fi
          done
          
          echo "rule_type_changes=$RULE_TYPE_CHANGES" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Comment on rule type parameter changes
        if: env.rule_type_changes == 'true'
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          script: |
            const { data: comments } = await github.rest.issues.listComments({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              issue_number: context.issue.number
            });

            const existingComment = comments.find(comment => 
              comment.body.includes('rule type parameter changes')
            );

            if (!existingComment) {
              await github.rest.issues.createComment({
                owner: context.repo.owner,
                repo: context.repo.repo,
                issue_number: context.issue.number,
                body: '⚠️ This PR modifies rule type parameters. Please ensure that any changes to rule types are properly reviewed by the contextual-security team. The cloud-security-posture team has been renamed to contextual-security.'
              });
            }
```
